measures.simple: How warm and how damp the air is near the ground, by day and by night.
measures.scientific: Surface air temperature, surface relative humidity and many profile fields, twice daily (≈13:30 and ≈01:30 local overpass), Level-3 monthly 1° grid.

how.simple: It reads the heat glow of the air from space, twice a day.
how.scientific: Hyperspectral infrared sounder (2378 channels); retrievals from cloud-cleared radiances.

name.scientific: GPM IMERG (Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM)

platform: GPM Core Observatory and partner satellites

measures.simple: How much rain and snow falls.
measures.scientific: Merged multi-satellite precipitation, gauge-adjusted (Final Run), monthly 0.1° grid; TRMM era before 2014, GPM era after.

how.simple: Many satellites watch clouds and rain, and rain gauges on the ground check them.
how.scientific: Passive-microwave and infrared estimates intercalibrated to the GPM core radar/radiometer, bias-adjusted with GPCC gauges.

measures.simple: How hazy the air is, and how much of some polluting gases it holds.
measures.scientific: Aerosol optical depth (OMAERUV), tropospheric NO₂ (OMNO2d), SO₂, ozone; daily Level-3 0.25° grids.

how.simple: It looks at sunlight bouncing back from the air and sees what the air holds.
how.scientific: UV-visible imaging spectrometer measuring backscattered solar radiance.

name.scientific: MERRA-2 (Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2)

measures.simple: Past weather everywhere on Earth, like temperature, rain, damp air and haze.
measures.scientific: Global atmospheric reanalysis (0.5° × 0.625°), assimilating satellite, station, balloon and aircraft observations, incl. aerosol optical depth.

how.simple: A computer rebuilds past weather from millions of real measurements.
how.scientific: GEOS-5 model with 3D-Var assimilation; observing-system changes over time can shift long-term values.

measures.simple: How wet the ground is, how much water goes back into the air, and snow.
measures.scientific: Noah land-surface model v2.1, monthly 0.25° grid; soil moisture, evapotranspiration, snow water equivalent, runoff. Land only.

how.simple: A computer works out how wet the ground is from rain, sun and weather.
how.scientific: Offline land-surface model forced by observation-based meteorology and precipitation.

measures.scientific: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm (Dark Target / Deep Blue combined), Level-3 monthly 1° grid.

how.simple: A camera in space sees how much the haze dims the ground below.
how.scientific: 36-band imaging radiometer; aerosol retrieval over dark and bright surfaces.

name.scientific: MOPITT (Measurements Of Pollution In The Troposphere)

measures.simple: How much carbon monoxide, a smoky gas, the air holds.
measures.scientific: Total-column carbon monoxide, Level-3 monthly 1° grid.

how.simple: It looks at heat and sunlight from below and spots the smoky gas.
how.scientific: Gas-correlation radiometer in thermal and near infrared.
